def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    sixes = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==6]
    def draw_line(r,c,dr,dc,col):
        r,c = r+dr, c+dc
        while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
            if out[r][c] not in (bg,col): break
            out[r][c]=col
            r+=dr; c+=dc
    def draw_seg(a, b, col):
        dr = (b[0]>a[0])-(b[0]<a[0]); dc = (b[1]>a[1])-(b[1]<a[1])
        r,c = a[0]+dr, a[1]+dc
        while (r,c)!=(b[0],b[1]):
            if out[r][c] in (bg,col): out[r][c]=col
            r+=dr; c+=dc
    paired = set()
    for i,a in enumerate(ones):
        for b in ones[i+1:]:
            if a[0]-b[0]==a[1]-b[1] or a[0]+a[1]==b[0]+b[1]:
                paired.add(a); paired.add(b)
                draw_seg(a,b,1)
    for s in sixes:
        aligned_ones = [o for o in ones if s[0]-o[0]==s[1]-o[1] or s[0]+s[1]==o[0]+o[1]]
        if aligned_ones:
            o = aligned_ones[0]
            dirs = ((1,-1),(-1,1)) if s[0]-o[0]==s[1]-o[1] else ((1,1),(-1,-1))
            for dr,dc in dirs:
                draw_line(s[0],s[1],dr,dc,6)
    for a in ones:
        if a in paired: continue
        corners = [(0,0),(0,w-1),(h-1,0),(h-1,w-1)]
        far = max(corners, key=lambda k:(abs(k[0]-a[0])+abs(k[1]-a[1])))
        dr = (far[0]>a[0])-(far[0]<a[0]); dc = (far[1]>a[1])-(far[1]<a[1])
        r,c = a
        while True:
            nr,nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if not (0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w): break
            nnr,nnc = nr+dr, nc+dc
            if not (0<=nnr<h and 0<=nnc<w): break
            if out[nr][nc] not in (bg,1): break
            out[nr][nc]=1
            r,c = nr,nc
    return out

for name,(gi,go) in {"d1":(demo1_in,demo1_out),"d2":(demo2_in,demo2_out),"d3":(demo3_in,demo3_out)}.items():

    diffs = [(r,c,t[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(len(go)) for c in range(len(go[0])) if t[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print(name, diffs)

print(J.dumps(out))

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    sixes = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==6]
    def draw_seg(a, b):
        dr = (b[0]>a[0])-(b[0]<a[0]); dc = (b[1]>a[1])-(b[1]<a[1])
        r,c = a[0]+dr, a[1]+dc
        while (r,c)!=(b[0],b[1]):
            if out[r][c] in (bg,1): out[r][c]=1   # passes through 6s (keeps 6)
            r+=dr; c+=dc
    # connect aligned 1 pairs (full segment through 6s)
    for i,a in enumerate(ones):
        for b in ones[i+1:]:
            if a[0]-b[0]==a[1]-b[1] or a[0]+a[1]==b[0]+b[1]:
                draw_seg(a,b)
    # 6s on a 1-line: emit full perpendicular line
    for s in sixes:
        al = [o for o in ones if s[0]-o[0]==s[1]-o[1] or s[0]+s[1]==o[0]+o[1]]
        if al:
            o = al[0]
            dirs = ((1,-1),(-1,1)) if s[0]-o[0]==s[1]-o[1] else ((1,1),(-1,-1))
            for dr,dc in dirs:
                r,c = s[0]+dr, s[1]+dc
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                    if out[r][c] in (bg,6): out[r][c]=6
                    r+=dr; c+=dc
    # lone 1s: ray toward farthest corner, through 6s, stop at 1s, exclude last in-grid cell
    oneset = set(ones)
    for a in ones:
        corners = [(0,0),(0,w-1),(h-1,0),(h-1,w-1)]
        far = max(corners, key=lambda k:(abs(k[0]-a[0])+abs(k[1]-a[1])))
        dr = (far[0]>a[0])-(far[0]<a[0]); dc = (far[1]>a[1])-(far[1]<a[1])
        r,c = a
        while True:
            nr,nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if not (0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w): break
            if (nr,nc) in oneset: break
            nnr,nnc = nr+dr, nc+dc
            if not (0<=nnr<h and 0<=nnc<w): break
            out[nr][nc]=1
            r,c = nr,nc
    return out

exec('''
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    sixes = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==6]
    def draw_seg(a, b):
        dr = (b[0]>a[0])-(b[0]<a[0]); dc = (b[1]>a[1])-(b[1]<a[1])
        r,c = a[0]+dr, a[1]+dc
        while (r,c)!=(b[0],b[1]):
            if out[r][c] in (bg,1): out[r][c]=1
            r+=dr; c+=dc
    for i,a in enumerate(ones):
        for b in ones[i+1:]:
